answer: Delay-Revealed Slot Lottery. Each epoch, an agent’s registration slot is assigned by hashing its identity with a randomness beacon revealed only after commitments close, so attackers cannot precompute which slots will be cheap. The beacon seeds a kernel that maps identities to arrival times, forcing sybils into a shared pool. A ferrous hardware delay line enforces the reveal timing. Each extra identity costs a full epoch of waiting plus a hardware challenge, making mass registration expensive. The haven of honest agents stays unreachable to burst attackers.
